thread:
Tara: hey folks — opened a small PR to add a quickstart for Dedicated provisioning that targets the 'small tenant' golden path. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Mike: looking now. main ask — does this example cover burstPolicy + isolation labels? customers hit surprises when burst preempts low-priority tenants.
Tara: good point. current snippet shows scalePolicy + cooldown but not burstPolicy; i added a short note in the PR description. thinking to include a tiny example YAML and a short SDK example for python/go.
Sasha: add a one-liner about SLA expectations when burstPolicy is enabled. e.g., "best-effort bursts do not change tenant SLA for reserved capacity" — doc wording maybe: "Bursts may incur preemption; Reserved SLAs apply to guaranteed capacity only." :thinking:
Oliver: +1 on the wording. also we should link to the dedicated SLA page (handbook link changed recently). doc-bot, can you confirm the canonical handbook link? :eyes:
doc-bot: Heads up — handbook page moved. canonical link: https://handbook.redwood.ai/dedicated/sla (redirects in place but update links in docs)
Tara: thanks. i'll replace the old /sizing link with the handbook link. here's the YAML I plan to add:

Tara: ```yaml
tenant:
  id: "acme-small"
  reservedPools:
    - pool: "dedicated-small"
  labels:
    isolation: "soft"
autoscale:
  scalePolicy: "cpu_based"
  burstPolicy:
    enabled: true
    maxBurstSeconds: 30
    evictionPriority: "low"
```

Mike: can we show a minimal python SDK example that creates the tenant and warns about label semantics? something like:
Mike: ```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
req = {
  "tenant_id": "acme-small",
  "reserved_pools": ["dedicated-small"],
  "labels": {"isolation": "soft"},
}
c.tenants.create(req)
```

Sasha: for the SDK snippet, prefer the real method names (create_tenant) and snake_case fields to match our SDK conventions. i can push a tiny patch on the PR.
Tara: ok i'll incorporate Sasha's tidyup. also adding a short migration note: "If you previously used `poolName` in tenant configs, migrate to `reservedPools` — the older key will be accepted for now but will be removed in v2.1". put that under a Migration heading.
Oliver: can you also add a short 'Testing' checklist? e.g., steps: 1) provision in staging, 2) run perf smoke test (10k tokens/min), 3) verify eviction behavior by lowering priority. 1-liners only.
Tara: done — added testing checklist and a link to the autoscale playbook. one more ask: do we need a cross-ref from 'dedicated provisioning' -> 'rollouts/fallbacks' docs so on capacity shortage the user sees recommended fallbacks?
Mike: yes, add a line: "Recommended fallback: route to a compatible smaller model variant or burst to shared pool with explicit consent."
Sasha: LGTM overall. i'll do a quick pass for wording and then approve.
Tara: thanks! i'll update the PR with the python naming fixes, the handbook link, the migration note, and the testing checklist. tagging @Mike and @Sasha for final eyes. :shipit!:shipit:
